name: hdl-h5-sv-uvm-v1
note: HDL track H5 (docs/HDL_DATA.md): SystemVerilog and UVM continued pretraining after H3. Every HDL project must pass a Verilator lint and a Yosys synth of its top module before it is used (fetch_mixture --projects gate, v5.186); a passing project is one document, its files in dependency order. Curated open cores carry most of the HDL weight: OpenTitan (per IP, Apache-2.0), Ibex (Apache-2.0), CVA6 (SHL-0.51), and the core-v-verif UVM environments once CVA6 passes. GitHub code (the Stack SystemVerilog, permissive repositories only, and Verilog_GitHub) is the low-weight long tail. Verilog and English + maths replay against forgetting.

sources.name: opentitan-sv
sources.license_note: Top-level LICENSE Apache-2.0; hw/vendor (third-party) excluded. About 38 MB of SystemVerilog, 12 MB of it UVM testbenches (hw/ip/*/dv, hw/dv).

sources.name: ibex-sv
sources.license_note: Top-level LICENSE Apache-2.0; vendor/ excluded. About 1.7 MB of SystemVerilog including the dv/uvm testbench.

sources.name: cva6-sv
sources.license_note: Top-level LICENSE is the Solderpad Hardware Licence 0.51 (permissive, based on Apache-2.0); LICENSE.Berkeley (BSD-3-Clause) and LICENSE.SiFive (Apache-2.0) cover parts. vendor/ excluded. The core/ directory, about 2 MB of SystemVerilog.

sources.name: core-v-verif-sv
sources.license_note: LICENSE.md is the Solderpad Hardware Licence 2.0, a wraparound that lets the user treat the work as Apache-2.0. vendor/ and vendor_lib/ excluded. About 4.3 MB of SystemVerilog, mostly UVM.

sources.name: stack-systemverilog
sources.license_note: The Stack terms of use must be accepted on the Hub by the account first. Rows are kept only when every licence in max_stars_repo_licenses is permissive (fetch_mixture.PERMISSIVE), then grouped by max_stars_repo_name: one repository is one project.

sources.name: verilog-github
sources.license_note: As in hdl_h1_cpt_v1: Verilog replay. No repository names, so each row (one file) is gated on its own.
